name: Download and Inspect Asset
description: Downloads an asset from Asset Manager and runs a read-only Asset Transformer script that prints scene statistics to the job log. A minimal get-asset plus custom-script pattern.

inputParameters.name: projectId
inputParameters.description: The project containing the asset to process.

inputParameters.name: assetId
inputParameters.description: The asset containing the files to process.

inputParameters.name: assetVersionId
inputParameters.description: The asset version containing the files to process.

inputParameters.script:
import argparse, glob, os
import pxz
from pxz import io, scene

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--input-dir', default='/workspace/input')
    a = p.parse_args()
    sources = [f for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(a.input_dir, '*')) if os.path.isfile(f)]
    root = io.importScene(sources[0])
    tris = scene.getPolygonCount([root], asTriangleCount=True)
    print('file:', os.path.basename(sources[0]))
    print('triangles:', tris)
    print('aabb:', scene.getAABB([root]))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
